name: paint-mv-storyboard
description: Writes STORYBOARD.md for a paint-mv music video the way the PDoomVideo storyboard was written, with everything specific taken from the song's own lyrics: a concept with a twist that bookends the video, a cast designed from who and what the lyrics sing about, one set per chapter drawn from the lyrics' imagery, a shot per lyric line and motivated transitions; then applies the plan to the project (song.js wipes and meter, chapter stubs, studio.html). Use when planning, writing or revising the concept, characters, chapters, shots or transitions of an MV made with paint-mv, or when asked for an MV storyboard / 分镜 / 镜头表 / 角色设计.
